{{Top|leg}}
The '''80-100 laser cannon''' was manufactured by [[Senko Systems]], and was the primary [[Laser/Legends|laser]] weapon on early versions of the [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]]. On such ships, double-helix prismatic [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] were used to generate the cannon's laser beam, giving the weapons a lifespan of approximately 20.000 shots before the crystal became unusable due to erosion.<ref name="XvT">''[[Starfighter Battle Book: X-wing vs TIE Interceptor]]''</ref>
